label: WHOLLY_GOOD_2: keeps the rescue duty unless every way of preventing violates a constraint
definition: ConstraintStandard s W: for every Rowe-wholly-good being and occurring event it can prevent, either preventing is not strictly better, or some way of preventing exists and every such way fails one of double-effect conditions 1–3. Doing/allowing shapes the rescue duty; it does not remove it.
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
